qc_finding: 5131 of 70152 test-half MPS rows carry a recorded result from a measurement whose RHE potential exceeded its OWN recorded instrument compliance limit by > 0.5 V. MPS records limit_potential_vref on 70152/70152 rows, which is the only reason this check is possible — this is a QC observation about individual measurements running past their recorded compliance, not an error by the authors.
